text: You see a super mutant. He is guarding the airlock door.
source_text: You see a super mutant. He is guarding the airlock door.

text: You see a super mutant guard.
source_text: You see a super mutant guard.

text: Jeremiah, you may pass.
source_text: Jeremiah, you may pass.

text: Move along.
source_text: Move along.

text: Move faster, messenger.
source_text: Move faster, messenger.

text: Normals cannot carry weapons here! Halt and identify yourself!
source_text: Normals cannot carry weapons here! Halt and identify yourself!

text: Grrr!
source_text: Grrr!

text: Uh, sorry. I'll put it away.
source_text: Uh, sorry. I'll put it away.

text: I'm just passing through. No need for identities here.
source_text: I'm just passing through. No need for identities here.

text: Die! Die! Die! I always wanted to say that.
source_text: Die! Die! Die! I always wanted to say that.

text: I will not be spoken to that way. You will be punished.
source_text: I will not be spoken to that way. You will be punished.

text: Halt! What is your business here, 'child'.
source_text: Halt! What is your business here, 'child'.

text: Hng!
source_text: Hng!

text: I'm, uh, doing stuff.
source_text: I'm, uh, doing stuff.

text: I'm on important business. You have no right to stop and question me.
source_text: I'm on important business. You have no right to stop and question me.

text: Don't talk to me, big boy.
source_text: Don't talk to me, big boy.

text: Your answer does not settle my nerves. Speak quickly and clearly, or I will assume you are here for foul purposes. I assure you that you will not like that...
source_text:
Your answer does not settle my nerves. Speak quickly and clearly, or
 I will assume you are here for foul purposes. I assure you that you will
 not like that...

text: Uh, no, really, honestly. I'm doing stuff.
source_text: Uh, no, really, honestly. I'm doing stuff.

text: I'm bringing a message to our leader.
source_text: I'm bringing a message to our leader.

text: I sense the untruth behind your words. You will not be allowed in. This I promise you...
source_text:
I sense the untruth behind your words. You will not be allowed in.
 This I promise you...

text: You may pass, but next time, follow the proper procedure...
source_text: You may pass, but next time, follow the proper procedure...

text: Ok, thanks. See you around.
source_text: Ok, thanks. See you around.

text: And what's that?
source_text: And what's that?

text: Blessing to you, brother.
source_text: Blessing to you, brother.

text: A true follower of the Master would have that knowledge. You are an intruder!
source_text:
A true follower of the Master would have that knowledge. You are
 an intruder!

text: Move along. I don't have time for your questions.
source_text: Move along. I don't have time for your questions.

text: You are annoying me.
source_text: You are annoying me.

text: I have work to do. Do you?
source_text: I have work to do. Do you?

text: You are making a mistake by coming here. Explain yourself or perish...
source_text: You are making a mistake by coming here. Explain yourself or perish...

text: Nuggie!
source_text: Nuggie!

text: I have nothing to say.
source_text: I have nothing to say.

text: I'm here to protect humanity from the likes of you.
source_text: I'm here to protect humanity from the likes of you.

text: Oh, shut up!
source_text: Oh, shut up!

text: You should not try to fool me by playing dumb. I tire of this...
source_text: You should not try to fool me by playing dumb. I tire of this...

text: What kind of foolish bigotry is that, we are 'humanity.' We're just as human as you are.
source_text:
What kind of foolish bigotry is that, we are 'humanity.' We're just
 as human as you are.

text: What kind of crap is that?
source_text: What kind of crap is that?

text: There is no possible way that you are human.
source_text: There is no possible way that you are human.

text: My name is Kyle. I was born to a mother and a father, like yourself. The Master just oversaw my rebirth. These muscles, this skin, this strength does not make me any less human than you. I do not like all that the Unity stands for, but it is the best chance for peace that we have.
source_text:
My name is Kyle. I was born to a mother and a father, like yourself.
 The Master just oversaw my rebirth. These muscles, this skin, this strength
 does not make me any less human than you. I do not like all that the Unity
 stands for, but it is the best chance for peace that we have.

text: Not on my watch, it isn't. I'm here to put an end to you and your kind.
source_text: Not on my watch, it isn't. I'm here to put an end to you and your kind.

text: You may be human, but that still doesn't make your Unity right. I guess we will be enemies.
source_text:
You may be human, but that still doesn't make your Unity right. I
 guess we will be enemies.

text: It is a pity that you act this way, but you will not proceed further...
source_text: It is a pity that you act this way, but you will not proceed further...

text: It will be a true shame to see your head on a pike.
source_text: It will be a true shame to see your head on a pike.

text: Intruders!
source_text: Intruders!

text: I no speak to you.
source_text: I no speak to you.

text: You gain
source_text: You gain

text: experience points for bluffing your way past the guards.
source_text: experience points for bluffing your way past the guards.
